plan.title: bug(telemetry): tool_turn_denominator has no production callers - shipped in schema, never emitted; #3352 trigger still unevaluable (#3320 residual)

narratives.Description: tool_turn_denominator shipped as a schema kind and emitter method with zero production callers. Field streams therefore cannot compute ritual share and the #3352 trigger stays unevaluable.
narratives.Overview:
**TL;DR: `tool_turn_denominator` shipped as a schema kind and an emitter method with zero production callers. Field streams confirm: no denominator event in any collected trial. Without it, ritual+gate share is not computable and the #3352 orient-Later trigger stays unevaluable — the exact condition #3320 was filed to end.**

**Evidence:** grep at HEAD: the only non-test reference to `tool_turn_denominator` outside the type union is the emitter method itself (`packages/core/src/run-summary/emit.ts:232`). Collected field JSONL (internal benchmark, private; framework 0.102.0) contains zero denominator events across all trials.

**Design note the implementer must solve, not dodge:** the CLI cannot see host tool turns. Candidate denominators: (a) count of CLI invocations per session as a proxy (cheap, undercounts), (b) host-supplied signal (`DEFT_MAX_TURNS`-style env or a host descriptor) recorded at session start with actuals unavailable, (c) emit per-invocation events and let the analyst join against harness-side turn counts. Pick one, document what the share means under it, and wire the caller. A denominator that measures something slightly different but is actually emitted beats a perfect one that never fires.

## Acceptance sketch
- A consumer trial with `DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH` set yields at least one denominator event per session, and `share = ritual_events / denominator` is computable from the stream alone.
- #3352 updated with the chosen semantics.

Relates #3320 (closed as shipped; the callers never landed), #3352 (blocked on this), #3286, #3282.
narratives.UserStory: As a telemetry analyst, I want at least one denominator event per session, so that ritual_events / denominator is computable from the stream alone.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In packages/core/src/session (session:start) or a single CLI invocation site, call RunSummaryEmitter.tool_turn_denominator so a consumer trial with DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH emits at least one denominator event. Document share = ritual_events / denominator on #3352. Do not change seq lock protocol in emit.ts. Evidence: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/run-summary packages/core/src/session plus CHANGELOG #3356.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a consumer trial with DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH set, when a session runs, at least one tool_turn_denominator event is present and share = ritual_events / denominator is computable from the stream alone.

clauses.text: A production caller exists at its stated path so a consumer trial with DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH yields at least one tool_turn_denominator event and share = ritual_events / denominator is computable from the stream.

Chosen denominator semantics exist at the stated path: share equals ritual_events divided by DEFT_TOTAL_TOOL_TURNS, else DEFT_MAX_TURNS / host maxTurns, else this CLI invocation (1). GitHub issue #3352 carries the same comment.
